تختفون (form VIII)
# تَخْتَفُونَ (taḵtafūna) /tax.ta.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
# تُخْتَفَوْنَ (tuḵtafawna) /tux.ta.faw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
